stages.name: Ready
stages.instructions: Wait for the Producer to bind an exact specialist installation and approved planning package.

stages.name: Specialist Execution
stages.instructions: Execute the canonical role-owned ticket. Code delivery returns code-published with its exact publication SHA; document delivery returns completed. Never report source publication as merged delivery.

stages.name: Technical Review
stages.instructions: Review the exact candidate patch against the accepted requirements. Return approved with the reviewed commit SHA, or rejected with actionable findings. This is a code review decision, not permission to merge.

stages.name: Independent QA
stages.instructions: Test the exact published and technically reviewed candidate SHA. Return passed or failed with source commit evidence, executed validations and findings. Do not change tracked source.

stages.name: Final Merge Authorization
stages.instructions: Verify that the candidate SHA is unchanged from technical review and has passing independent QA. Authorize that exact SHA through the Git broker and return approved; reject changed or unacceptable candidates with feedback.

stages.name: Governed Merge
stages.instructions: Merge only the exact QA-passed and lead-authorized source publication through the trusted platform action.

stages.name: Producer Review
stages.instructions: Verify the exact output evidence and acceptance criteria without overriding creative or QA authority.
